test.create_query: CREATE TABLE reverse_string_mixed (s String, f FixedString(256)) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO reverse_string_mixed SELECT if(number % 5 = 0, '', repeat('x', number % 1024)), toFixedString(repeat('x', 256), 256) FROM numbers(500000)
test.query: SELECT reverse(materialize(repeat('x', 8))) FROM numbers(10000000) FORMAT Null
